```
FUNCTION_BLOCK AerationBlowerDelayedStart
VAR_INPUT
    DO_LOW : BOOL;
    AERATION_E_STOP_NC : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    BLOWER_RUN : BOOL := FALSE;
    AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT : UINT := 0;
END_VAR
VAR
    local_startTimer : TON;
    local_runRise : R_TRIG;
END_VAR

(* ENGINEERING_CONTRACT
 BLOWER_RUN: activation via TON.Q when DO_LOW AND AERATION_E_STOP_NC have been TRUE for >= T#5S (PUB001); holds while conditions remain TRUE and timer Q true; immediate deactivation/reset via TON.IN=false when DO_LOW FALSE or E_STOP active (PUB002); same-scan priority: disable/reset takes precedence over enable; BOOL, unitless.
 AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT: increment on FALSE->TRUE transition of BLOWER_RUN using R_TRIG (PUB003); retained; no explicit reset specified; counts UINT starts, wraps at 65535 by standard UINT arithmetic boundary (PUB003/PUB004).
 Startup: BLOWER_RUN initialized FALSE and count 0; timer idle (PUB004).
*)

(* CONTRACT_RULES [] *)

local_startTimer(IN := DO_LOW AND AERATION_E_STOP_NC, PT := T#5S);
BLOWER_RUN := local_startTimer.Q;
local_runRise(CLK := BLOWER_RUN);
IF local_runRise.Q THEN
    AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT := AERATION_BLOWER_CYCLE_COUNT + UINT#1;
END_IF;
```
